name: @mm/gym-bridge
description: The out-of-process agent boundary: a line-delimited JSON protocol over stdio that carries agent-api's observation, legality mask, candidate lists and outcome record to a Python client — contracts.md §4 and §5.
author: Ann Kelner
//: contracts.md §5 grants this package one edge, to @mm/agent-api, and that is the whole dependency list. It is host-side — it owns a process's stdin and stdout — so it sees Node's ambient types and is outside the rules-path float ban, but it performs no normalization of its own: §4.1 makes agent-api's normalize.ts the single licensed float boundary, and a bridge that rescaled anything would decouple what a policy learns from what the harness measures. It is a leaf; nothing in this workspace imports it.
